underhall.intro: A Mossback and a Hum Wisp block the stair!
underhall.wonMsg: Victory! The humming fades from the hall.
underhall.lostMsg: The party is driven back up the stair.
won: It has gone quiet. For now.
Then I am going back to my gate.
That is the end of this slice. Next: the rest of the dungeon.
lost: The party scrambles back up the stair to catch its breath.
Again, when you are ready. Use Shield Wall when the big one stomps.
